# #222 — Add scoped hot working set for realtime agent sessions

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy

Parent epic: #220

Research receipt: PR #225, `docs/realtime-agent-memory-research.md`.

## Problem

Realtime agents need instant access to the current live conversation state in
the exact agent/server/channel/thread/session scope. If Hermes must decide every
turn what to retrieve, it will miss recent corrections, current user intent, and
active task state.

## Goal

Add an Open Brain hot working set model for active realtime sessions. This is
RAM-first working memory that is usable only by the exact active scope and is
not durable known memory.

## Required Scope

- Scope key:
  `namespace + agent + platform/source + server/guild + channel + optional thread + session key`
- Maintain a rolling hot set for active sessions:
  - recent raw/structured events;
  - distilled current intent;
  - active corrections/reactions;
  - current task state;
  - selected linked durable memories;
  - next-turn response guidance;
  - confidence/staleness markers.
- Per-session and global memory budgets.
- TTL and purge policy.
- Explicit exclusion from normal durable recall/shared-kb.

## Trust Boundary

The working set is usable by the same exact scope only. It must not spill across:

- agents;
- servers/guilds;
- channels;
- threads;
- sessions;
- durable/global recall.

## Relationship To Context Pack

`agent_context_pack` may include working-set items only on exact-scope match.
Working-set items must be labeled as working context, not durable facts,
decisions, or shared knowledge.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Contract defines `working_set` structure and scope predicate.
- `agent_context_pack` includes working-set items only on exact-scope match.
- Tests prove cross-scope denial.
- Working-set items are labeled as working context, not durable facts/decisions.
- Budget defaults are documented, including global cap and per-session cap.
- Metrics/counters expose dropped/expired/trimmed working-set entries.

## First Next Action

Define exact-scope RAM working-set schema and budget rules before implementation.
